data.body:
[P1] Reconcile native attempts against service history

Only `WRAPPER_ENTER` records populate this inventory; service completion records for other request IDs are ignored. If the original invocation emits no ledger stream but its retry does, `_bind_requests` assigns the retry the original role. Validation and retirement can then accept evidence that omits the original attempt. Reconcile service-reported request IDs against the launch journal and ledger, and mark missing streams incomplete before issuing watermarks or permitting target reuse. Add a regression with a service-recorded original and only its retry present in the ledger.
